findings.game: pit lane on the right, 80 km/h, 500 m long: entry 164 m before the line, exit 164 m after
findings.real: right side, 80 km/h (FIA 2026 decision: "the pit lane speed limit which is set at 80 km/h for this event"); OSM pit lane way 38168747 741 m: leaves the track 559 m before the line (Curva Alboreto exit), rejoins 182 m after it; real pit loss ~25.4 s (MultiViewer pitLoss.normal)
findings.proposedFix: side / limit correct; layout note: the generic 500 m lane is ~240 m shorter than the real one (pit-stop time loss too small); a data-driven lane (entry / exit arc positions from OSM) would fix it

findings.game: range 22.4 m; invented hills up to 4.9% / -6.1% (50 m) around Lesmo; highest point s ~2900 (Curva del Serraglio) 22.4 m above the lowest
findings.real: range 12.4 m (F1 live-timing car heights, 2026 qualifying), 12 m (TINITALY 10 m DTM), 12.8 m (formula1.com); en.wikipedia: "generally flat, but has a gradual gradient from the second Lesmos to the Variante Ascari"; real grades over 100 m: TINITALY +2.3% / -1%, car heights +3.3% / -2.4% (the +3.3% is on the start straight where the timing heights carry a pit-lane artefact). Game vs car heights: rms 3.86 m, max 10.7 m at s 2905 (328 m after T7 / Curva del Serraglio); grade over 100 m rms 2.16 pp, max 5.2 pp. Invented slopes (> 2 pp over 100 m): s 2345-2475 (153 m after T6): game -5.5% vs -0.2%; s 2550-2825 (78 m after T7): game 4.7% vs -0.5%; s 820-1025 (232 m before T3 / Curva Biassono): game 4.6% vs 0.2%; s 3800-3895 (T10 / Variante Ascari): game 3.4% vs -0.3%; s 2105-2290 (T6 / Lesmo 1): game 2.7% vs -0.8%; s 3955-4090 (154 m after T10): game -4.1% vs -0.6%; s 1100-1270 (T3 / Curva Biassono): game -3.2% vs 0.2%
findings.proposedFix: elevation source: the proposedCorrections.elevation profile (F1 live-timing car heights, TINITALY on the start straight), range 12.4 m; or at least TINITALY 10 m (range 12 m) instead of GLO-90 (the park's trees are in the surface model). No lidar was reachable (Regione Lombardia geoportal / cartografia.servizirl.it time out from here; the national PCN lidar WMS answers 403)

findings.game: Lesmo 2 -> Ascari: one long descent from the invented hump (s 2950-3600: -11.1 m, steepest -3.5%/100 m); no dip at the underpass
findings.real: the road dips ~5 m to pass under the old banking: car heights 192.7 m (s 3005) -> 187.6 m (s 3300, the underpass) -> 190.9 m (s 3595), -1.7% / +1.2%; formula1.com: "the significant dip coming on the drag between the second Lesmo (Turn 7) and Ascari (Turn 8)"; TINITALY (10 m, interpolated) misses the cut
findings.proposedFix: comes with the proposed profile (the live-timing heights carry the dip)
sources: F1 live-timing archive (feed read by FastF1): https://livetiming.formula1.com/static/2026/2026-09-06_Italian_Grand_Prix/2026-09-05_Qualifying/Position.z.jsonStream (car X / Y / Z ~4 Hz; cached devtests/track-audit/cache/f1livetiming/)

findings.game: curvature-derived banking only; max per corner: Rettifilo di partenza 3.5, Variante del Rettifilo -5.8, Curva Biassono 1.3, Variante della Roggia -5.5, Lesmo 1 3.8, Lesmo 2 5.1, Curva del Serraglio -0.9, Curva Vialone -4.9, Variante Ascari -4.5, Curva Alboreto 3.8 deg
findings.real: no published bank angle for the road course (en.wikipedia only: Lesmo 1 "has a slight banking"; the 1955 oval bankings are not on the F1 lap). Not measured: no lidar reachable for Monza from here (see elevation)

findings.real: the F1 lap passes UNDER the old high-speed oval: OSM way 34404729 (raceway, bridge=yes, layer 1, "anello alta velocità") over F1 way 1443867793 (covered=yes, 25 m) at s ~3283-3310, between Curva del Serraglio and Curva Vialone (Ascari); footbridges over the track at s ~4124 (way 194458113, covered) and s ~4418 (way 194458112); the podium bridge-building (way 219396377 "Podio") over the main straight ~270 m before the line
findings.proposedFix: scenery: a concrete banking bridge at s ~3292 (the landmark) and the footbridges (proposedCorrections.bridgesOver)
